titles.romaji: Watashi to Kotori to Suzu to

description: The poem Watashi to Kotori to Suzu to was originally written by Misuzu Kaneko. Composer Ryuichi Sugimoto converted the poem into a song and it was sung by Tsutomu Aragaki. This song was animated for NHK's Minna no Uta program.
